- [IRET.28.14.2] Memory at slot capacity `cap`: `slots` `4·cap` plus dense
  `(ksize+vsize+8)·cap` (the `+8` is `dhash` 4 + `dslot` 4). Versus a
  hypothetical inline table this adds ~`8` bytes per slot (~11 bytes per
  live entry at 70 % load), in exchange for free O(len) cache-tight
  iteration (subsuming `occ[]`) and `u32` probing. This is acceptable at
  Rete table sizes (10²–10⁴ entries, per `[IRET.17]`).
